title: Anatomy sync
description: Keeps the Pack anatomy island in step with the code. Its reader (reader.ts) reads each file's imports, pack and header comment the way the structure test checks the architecture; its extractors (extract.ts), one per kind of source, turn the manifests, the modules, the tests and the structure checks into the island's keyed items and links; and its plan (plan.ts) is what a run sends: from what changed since the island's last sync, or in full. The handler that runs it on each push comes later; scripts/anatomy.ts runs it from git.
